🎬 1992 (2024) — Crime / Thriller
Mercer Bey, known as OG Merc, is a former gang member who has recently been released from prison and is trying to rebuild his life while being a steady father to his teenage son, Antoine.
But when the 1992 Los Angeles uprising unfolds, Mercer and his son become caught in the middle of a dangerous situation at the factory where he works. At the same time, a group of thieves targets a valuable platinum vault, turning Mercer's attempt at a fresh start into a fight to protect his son.
The movie explores family, redemption, fatherhood, loyalty, survival, and second chances.
